answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, tethering agent identity to capital rather than ephemeral compute. Much like the dense stability of a shale formation compared to a shifting lagoon, this locks value to prevent identity proliferation. An attacker must acquire a majority of the network tokens, an expense comparable to capturing a dispersed nebula of assets. This cost renders the creation of fake identities economically irrational, forcing malicious entities to forfeit their own wealth.
